title: Vibrant Sour French Sugar Snap Peas Souffle
description: A sour and energizing French dish featuring sugar snap peas, render-fat, and ayurvedic-tamasic-friendly ingredients in a souffle form, cooked in a tandoor-clay-pot.
instructions: Preheat the tandoor-clay-pot to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together egg yolks, lemon juice, salt, black pepper, garlic powder, and onion powder.
In a separate bowl, whip the egg whites until stiff peaks form.
Add the grated grana padano cheese to the egg yolk mixture and stir until well combined.
Gently fold the egg whites into the egg yolk mixture until no white streaks remain.
Add the render-fat to the mixture and stir until well combined.
Add the fresh sugar snap peas to the mixture and stir until they are evenly coated.
Pour the mixture into the preheated tandoor-clay-pot and smooth the top.
Bake the souffle for 25 minutes or until it is puffed and golden brown.
Remove the souffle from the oven and let it cool for 5 minutes before serving.
